edge_requirements.text: Contributors can see the current CI baseline for pull requests, main pushes, and nightly runs, with waiting time, execution time, run conclusions, and reruns recorded separately.
Maintainers can identify the largest runtime costs from saved job/step/test measurements, including setup and cache work, and use a ranked list to select improvements.

items.resolution: Interrupted acquisition retains a durable request/selection ledger and incomplete status; a second collector cannot mutate the same snapshot directory concurrently. Offline replay never performs a network request.
items.reason: Approved honesty/identity/budget decisions plus routine deterministic collector behavior; verified with contract fixtures.
items.probe: If interrupted or run in parallel, what is guaranteed?

items.resolution: Distinct test/job/attempt identities remain separate even when names or durations match; tied costs do not merge independent records.

items.probe: When two things are exactly equal or just touch, do they merge, collide, or separate?

items.resolution: Empty, missing or invalid eligible measurements produce an explicit unknown/insufficient-data result, never zero-cost or successful comparison; a single valid observation is reported with n=1 and its limits.
